race.comment: BRUTALRULE (7) has come back well, winning his maiden nicely fresh at Casterton before just finding one better out to 1700m at Warrnambool. He can improve again third up and draws much better here, expect he can sit in the first few and give a sight. HABITUAL (8) was a dominant maiden winner two back, solid as favourite last time at Swan Hill in a BM62. This suits nicely and with a good ride from a tricky gate he'll be hard to hold out. JUST SWIFT (11) is racing consistently, a winner two back at Ballarat Synthetic then good again at Donald. She'll be thereabouts again. CATALONA (14) is fresh and will be running on from back in the field.
